Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1”.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some sparrows are kites.

All kites are crows.

**Conclusions:**

I. All sparrows are crows.

Il. Some crows are sparrows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor Il follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
**__The Venn diagram of the given statements is as follows:__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2119f6ad2aafdd9f189afd761383ade6f79ffc89343fec62f4f57275db498b3c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All sparrows are crows → Doesn't **Follows** (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some crows are sparrows. → **Follows** (Because all kites are crows and some sparrows are kites.)

Hence, "only conclusion II follows" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five persons, A, B, C, D, and E are sitting on a bench all facing the park. D is second left of C but immediate right of B. If E is on the extreme left of the bench and sitting adjacent to B, what is the exact location of A?
questions.solution:
Given:

Five persons are: A, B, C, D, and E

They all are sitting on the bench and all facing the park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7462bb8d2b33d2b121022f5f43f6112198be4e7b338f7c308056c34435884b75.png] 

(1) E is on the extreme left of the bench and sitting adjacent to B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9eb15fdc21684c27746555dbdb2ac2345656f7292e1a21e67313eca10510aee.png] 

 
• As E is on the extreme left of the bench and sitting adjacent to B so, B is on the immediate right of E.

(2) D is the second left of C but the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6104da849a93e7e1c63c04e2caa913821f1e26a1fbad15db5a64a710a4e6524e.png] 

 
• As D is the immediate right of B and also the second left of C. So, A is left of C and right of D.

So, according to the diagram **the exact location of A is Left of C**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Which two digits and signs can be interchanged so as to balance the given equation?

18 × 7 ÷ 36 + 78 - 14 = 86
questions.solution:
**__BODMAS RULE:__**

 
 

 **B**
 
 
Brackets in order (),{},[]

 
 
 

 
 
**O**

 
 
 
of

 
 
 

 
 
**D**

 
 
 
Division (÷)

 
 
 

 
 
**M**

 
 
 
Multiplication (×)

 
 
 

 
 
**A**

 
 
 
Addition (+)

 
 
 

 
 
**S**

 
 
 
Subtraction (-)

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Given equation is 18 × 7 ÷ 36 + 78 - 14 = 86

 

**Option 1):**

By interchanging (6 and 4) and (- and +) in the given equation

Interchanged equation is : 18 × **__7 ÷ 34__** - 78 +16 = 86

⇒ **__18 × 0.206__** - 78 +16 = 86

⇒ ** 3.708** – 78 + **16** = 86

⇒ **__3.708 + 16__** – 78 = 86

⇒ **__19.708 - 78__** = 86

⇒ - 58.292 ≠ 86

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 2):**

By interchanging (1 and 4) and (× and ÷) in the given equation

Interchanged equation is : **__48 ÷ 7__** × 36 + 78 - 41 = 86

⇒ **__6.86 × 36__** + 78 – 41 = 86

⇒ **__246.96 + 78 __**– 41 = 86

⇒ 324.96 – 41 = 86

⇒ **__283.96 ≠ 86__**

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 3):**

By interchanging (3 and 4) and (× and +) in the given equation

Interchanged equation is : 18 + **__7 ÷ 46__** × 78 - 13 = 86

⇒ 18 + **__0.152 × 78 __**– 13 = 86

⇒ **__18 + 11.856__** – 13 = 86

⇒ 29.856 – 13 = 86

⇒ **__16.856 ≠ 86__**

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

**Option 4): **

By interchanging (4 and 3) and (÷ and -) in the given equation

Interchanged equation is : 18 × 7 – 46 +** __78 ÷ 13__** = 86

⇒ **__18 × 7__** – 46 + 6 = 86

⇒ 126 – 46 + 6 = 86

⇒ **__126 + 6__** – 46 = 86

⇒ **__132 – 46 = 86__**

⇒ **LHS = RHS** 

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
